Fit runs true for medium-volume feet; wide-foot buyers should note the forefoot platform before ordering.

faqs.question: Is the REI Co-op 2 Person Tent true to size?
faqs.answer: Most buyers report a true-to-size fit. If you wear thick cushioned hiking socks or custom orthotics, order a half size up.

faqs.question: How does it perform in sustained rain?
faqs.answer: In our 60-minute submersion protocol the PU-coated 68D polyester taffeta (1500mm floor) showed zero ingress. For multi-day storms, re-treat seams seasonally.
